datasets.title: IGAD Region - Dekadal Combined Drought Indicator(CDI) 2023
datasets.description: Dekadal(10days) Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) as implemented in the East Africa Drought Watch, and which is used for detecting and monitoring areas that either are affected or have the potential to be affected by meteorological, agricultural and/or hydrological drought.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/igad-region-dekadal-combined-drought-indicator-cdi-2023]

contact_point.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

creator.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

lineage.description: The CDI is a composite drought monitoring index implemented by ICPAC within the East Africa Drought Watch system. Dekadal (10-day) CDI raster grids for 2023 were generated by integrating multiple drought indicators to detect and monitor areas affected by or vulnerable to meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought across the IGAD region.

sources.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)
sources.description: East Africa Drought Watch Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) implementation that integrates meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought monitoring indices into a unified dekadal drought hazard assessment product.
